name: morphdoc
description: 面向结构化 Markdown 的主题化文档创作与发布工具

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web-runtime && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/font-pack-builder run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/server run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/desktop run build
scripts.build:web-runtime: pnpm --filter @morphdoc/markdown-echarts run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/core run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/semantic-document run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-theme-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/font-pack-registry run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/renderer run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/preview-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/application run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/web run build

scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm --filter @morphdoc/markdown-echarts run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/core run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/semantic-document run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/font-pack-registry run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/renderer run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/preview-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/application run build && concurrently -k -n web,desktop "pnpm:dev:web" "pnpm:dev:desktop"
scripts.desktop:package: pnpm run build:font-pack && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/desktop run package
scripts.desktop:package:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:font-pack && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/desktop run package:mac:arm64
scripts.desktop:package:mac:x64: pnpm run build:font-pack && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/desktop run package:mac:x64
scripts.build:font-pack: pnpm --filter @morphdoc/core run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-theme-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/font-pack-registry run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/font-pack-builder run build && node scripts/build-font-packs.mjs
scripts.verify:docker-font-pack: pnpm run verify:font-pack && pnpm run build:web-runtime && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/server run build && node deploy/verify-font-pack-compose.mjs
scripts.desktop:make:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:font-pack && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/desktop run make:mac:arm64
scripts.desktop:make:mac:x64: pnpm run build:font-pack && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/desktop run make:mac:x64
scripts.desktop:make:mac: pnpm run desktop:make:mac:arm64 && pnpm run desktop:make:mac:x64
scripts.verify:docx-reference: pnpm --filter @morphdoc/core run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run verify:pandoc
scripts.verify:docx-conversion: pnpm --filter @morphdoc/core run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run verify:conversion
scripts.verify:docx-matrix: pnpm --filter @morphdoc/core run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run verify:acceptance
scripts.verify:docx-themes: pnpm run build:web-runtime && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/server run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/server run verify:docx-theme-styles && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/docx-engine run verify:themes

scripts.verify:docx-page-decorations: pnpm run build:web-runtime && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/document-visual-diff run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/server run build && node scripts/verify-docx-page-decoration-visuals.mjs

scripts.verify:docx-release-gate-suite: pnpm run test:docx-layout-visual-matrix-cases && pnpm run test:docx-real-world-corpus && pnpm run test:docx-release-gate-suites && pnpm run verify:font-pack && pnpm run build:web-runtime && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/document-visual-diff run build && pnpm --filter @morphdoc/server run build && node scripts/verify-docx-release-gate-suite.mjs
